name: GET_rest_timemanagement_absence_v1_timeAccountBalances
title: GET_rest_timemanagement_absence_v1_timeAccountBalances
description: Gets time accounts of the entered user with their respective balances. If no user is entered, the logged in user is used.

parameters.name: $at
parameters.description: The date for which the balances are requested. The date must be in the format YYYY-MM-DD.

parameters.name: assignmentId
parameters.description: The assignmentUUID of the user for whom the balances are requested. If no user is entered, the logged in user is used.

name: GET_rest_timemanagement_absence_v1_timeTypeBalances
title: GET_rest_timemanagement_absence_v1_timeTypeBalances
description: Gets time types of the active user with their respective balances. If specified, only the balances of the main absence time type is returned.

parameters.name: $at
parameters.description: The date for which the balances are requested. The date must be in the format YYYY-MM-DD.

parameters.name: mainAbsenceTimeTypeBalanceOnly
parameters.description: If true, only the balances of the main absence time type are returned.

parameters.name: favoriteTimeTypeBalances
parameters.description: If true, only the balances of the favorite time types are returned. If false, the balances of non-favorite time types are returned. If not specified, the balances of all time types are returned.

name: GET_rest_timemanagement_absence_v1_terminationTimeAccountBalance
title: GET_rest_timemanagement_absence_v1_terminationTimeAccountBalances
description: Gets time accounts of the entered user with their respective termination balances. If no user is entered, the logged in user is used.

parameters.name: $at
parameters.description: The termination date for which the balances are requested for the user. The date must be in the format YYYY-MM-DD. If no date is entered, the termination date is derived by the system and the balances on this date are returned. The date is mandatory when the API is called with preview=true.

parameters.name: assignmentId
parameters.description: The assignmentUUID of the user for whom the balances are requested. If no user is entered, the logged in user is used.

parameters.name: preview
parameters.description: Indicator whether the termination shall be simulated if the user has not been terminated for the given date. If no value is entered, the preview is defaulted to false. Preview can only be used if there is no termination at the provided date, otherwise the request will fail.
